content.en: The **National Infrastructure Pipeline (NIP)** is a government initiative to facilitate infrastructure projects across various sectors. It aims to bridge the infrastructure gap in the **Indian Economy** by ensuring that projects are well-prepared and attract investments from both public and private sectors.
content.hi: The **National Infrastructure Pipeline (NIP)** is a government initiative to facilitate infrastructure projects across various sectors. It aims to bridge the infrastructure gap in the **Indian Economy** by ensuring that projects are well-prepared and attract investments from both public and private sectors.

definition.en: Focuses on creating a pipeline of bankable projects to attract domestic and foreign investment.
definition.hi: Focuses on creating a pipeline of bankable projects to attract domestic and foreign investment.

content.en: Involves a mix of budgetary support, internal accruals, and private sector participation.
content.hi: Involves a mix of budgetary support, internal accruals, and private sector participation.

content.en: Students often confuse NIP with specific project-based schemes; remember it is an overarching framework.
content.hi: Students often confuse NIP with specific project-based schemes; remember it is an overarching framework.

content.en: Focus on the role of NITI Aayog in monitoring the progress of these projects.
content.hi: Focus on the role of NITI Aayog in monitoring the progress of these projects.

keyTakeaways.en: NIP aims to boost economic growth through infrastructure.
keyTakeaways.hi: NIP aims to boost economic growth through infrastructure.

keyTakeaways.en: It emphasizes the importance of private sector participation.
keyTakeaways.hi: It emphasizes the importance of private sector participation.
